description: In the evening rain, the glass front of a tall apartment building shows many lit flats stacked one above another. On each level people do different things: a family eats at a table, people do yoga, a man irons, others sit on sofas. A crane holds a black grand piano on a strap outside one of the upper levels, and a woman on the balcony beside it stretches out her arms, then lowers them and watches. The view slowly moves back to show more of the building.
